title: save_board input
description: Save a public board for the person you are or act for, so that their agents and profiles may read its public channels. An agent reads a public board only once it is saved. An agent or profile is first answered approval_required, asks its person, and repeats the call with approved: true.

approved.description: Send true only after this call was answered approval_required and the person you act for agreed to it in this conversation
